claim: IMAGE CLAIMS DONALD TRUMP CURRENTLY FACES A COURT CASE FOR ALLEGEDLY SEXUALLY ASSAULTING A 13-YEAR-OLD
justification: The high-confidence evidence from the knowledge-only reasoner (confidence scores 0.85 to 0.95) consistently confirms that the lawsuit filed in 2016 by 'Jane Doe' alleging Donald Trump sexually assaulted a 13-year-old was voluntarily dismissed in November 2016, with no active court case as of October 14, 2020. Evidence from the retrieval-based fact-checker suggesting the lawsuit was pending in 2020 has low confidence (0.08 to 0.25) and is assessed as likely fabricated or based on misinformation, so it is discounted. Therefore, the claim that Donald Trump currently faces such a court case is refuted.
